name: Sunny Patel
look: a cheerful, energetic young delivery man with warm brown skin, a big smile, curly black hair and a thin curled moustache; a yellow cap, a yellow polo shirt with dark trim, dark cargo trousers with a belt, a wristwatch, yellow-and-dark sneakers, carrying a cardboard parcel under one arm and a green bike helmet in the other hand
